title: AI Chat Interactions: Try Any Model and Set It Up as You Chat | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Sometimes you want to talk to an AI model without building an assistant first. A chat interaction in the CrestApps AI module is a free-form chat where you choose the model, the instructions, the persona and the tools in a panel right beside the conversation, and everything is saved as you change it.

In this video:
• Why a chat interaction saves you the setup of a profile
• Starting an interaction and chatting
• The Settings tab: model, persona, instructions and fine-tuning
• The Capabilities tab: letting the AI use tools
• Reopening, copying, clearing and deleting interactions
• The site settings behind the voice options
• Use cases: trying a model, drafting text, testing instructions
